fieldValues.title: Planning: read the rendered spec as a human and propose the rewrite units
fieldValues.summary: A read-through of the rendered specification that produces this wave's unit list, rather than assuming it. Each proposed unit is cut against rulings A and B of 2026-09-17 before it is recorded.
fieldValues.body:
The rewrite units for this wave are not assumed — they come out of a read-through. Read the rendered specification front to back as a person new to it would, note where the thread breaks, where a concept arrives before anything introduces it, and where a Part reads as a list rather than an argument, and propose one rewrite unit per Part from what is actually there.

Cut every proposed unit against the rulings of 2026-09-17 (the-greenman/srs#787, comment 5712896993): order and membership for a story live at EXPRESSION — Containers for context membership and nesting, the Composition section's memberOrder for context order, the MEANING tree untouched — and concepts describe themselves, so bridging and introductory prose belongs to the concept record and is rendered at its heading. A proposal that needs a narrative leaf type or presentation-only text on the Composition is a proposal that has not been cut against the rulings.

The output is the nine per-Part rewrite units, plus the readability check and the proof read-through, recorded here as units under this phase. Nothing else in this wave starts until they exist.
